style.name: Dark Liquid Glass
style.description: Premium futuristic SaaS interface inspired by Apple's liquid glass aesthetic, combining deep dark backgrounds, translucent glass surfaces, soft blur, subtle reflections, and minimal monochrome UI.

colors.accent: subtle white, blue, purple and gray highlights

background.base: almost black with a very subtle deep blue tint
effects: subtle blue or purple ambient glow
background.intensity: low and atmospheric, never bright or distracting

glass.depth: multiple translucent layers creating floating glass depth

typography.font: modern sans-serif similar to Inter, SF Pro or Geist
typography.hierarchy: strong white titles, muted gray secondary text
typography.weight: medium to semibold, avoid excessive boldness

icons.appearance: Lucide, Phosphor or SF Symbols inspired

components.cards: dark translucent glass with thin borders, soft blur and subtle depth
components.buttons: minimal glass buttons; primary actions can use a light white glass surface
components.inputs: dark translucent rounded fields with subtle borders and soft focus glow
components.badges: small rounded pills with very subtle semantic color accents
components.panels: large floating glass surfaces with stronger blur and depth
components.modals: elevated translucent glass with strong backdrop blur
components.navigation: dark glass sidebar with highlighted active item

effects.motion: subtle fade, slide and scale animations

visual_rules.primary_rule: Everything should feel like transparent glass floating over a dark environment.
visual_rules.contrast: high readability without harsh pure-black and pure-white blocks
visual_rules.colors: mostly monochrome with restrained accent colors
visual_rules.depth: achieved through blur, transparency, borders, reflections and layered surfaces
